title: Local Cilium NetworkPolicy enforcement validation
objective: Validate default-deny and bounded DNS egress behavior in the existing local Kind cluster without running node clients or contacting AWS.

include: local evidence and teardown of probes

acceptance: Cilium is scoped to the existing named local Kind cluster
No workload StatefulSet is scaled above zero
Probe resources are deleted after testing
Evidence distinguishes local dataplane behavior from EKS CNI behavior
